details.effect: [fanfare] Banish two 1-cost cards from your cemetery: Choose up to 2 of the following. (1) Select an enemy follower on the field and destroy it. (2) Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader. (3) Draw a card. Discard a card. [act] [cost01], Lesson (1): Give this follower Rush.

effect.label: Banish two 1-cost cards from your cemetery

options.label: Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader
Draw a card. Discard a card

issues: Fanfare is incorrectly placed in keywords; remove "fanfare" from keywords and keep it only as the ability timing.
The fanfare optional cost says "Banish two 1-cost cards from your cemetery," but the banishFromCemetery filter only has maxCost: 1; it should require exactly 1-cost cards, not 0- or 1-cost cards.

Choice (2) says "Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader," but the parsed effect uses dealDamageAllEnemies, which hits enemy field/leader scope rather than leaders only; encode this as damage to enemy leaders specifically.
The activated ability is missing the engage cost from "[act] [cost01], Lesson (1)"; add engage: true to the activated cost if Lesson (1) corresponds to engaging this card plus the lesson payment.

The activated ability's Lesson (1) cost is encoded as banishFromExArea of a Magical Item, but the source text does not specify a Magical Item banish here; replace this with the correct Lesson (1) cost encoding rather than an unsupported inferred cost.
